persona: ETL tester who automated warehouse checks
resumeText:
Karan Malhotra | Gurugram | karan.malhotra@example.com

EXPERIENCE
ETL Test Engineer, Aravalli Analytics, Gurugram (2020 - present)
- Wrote SQL reconciliation checks between source Oracle tables and the Snowflake warehouse.
- Test daily ELT pipelines end to end for 120 finance tables.
- Built a Python framework that runs data checks after each load.
- Added Soda Core checks for freshness and null rates on critical tables.
- Profiled customer data and defined data quality rules with the finance team.
- Run the checks in Jenkins so failed data tests block releases.

SKILLS
SQL, Python, Snowflake, PySpark, Airflow

EDUCATION
BTech Information Technology, Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, 2020
